notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Greetings Shoppers!

This foggy night's update includes a handful of bug fixes, some new products from Ellie around the store, and some updates to the mannequin's behavior.  I completely changed the way her movement is processed, but in theory shoppers shouldn't really see too much of a difference.  We did make her move a little slower, hopefully prevented her occasional cheating, and added another option to her repertoire.  Hopefully this makes the blessed difficulty a little easier for people to explore in.  If you run into issues or its not behaving the way you expect, please let us know.

There are a few other minor changes as we try and focus the rest of our efforts on getting the main story of the game completed.  Short of major bugs or problems we're going to be focusing on getting all the things done we need for our (hopefully) August release schedule.  The new areas are coming along quite well and we're looking forward to getting [strike]meat processing to full capacity[/strike] areas open to explore.

Safe shopping out there, we'll see you in the mist.

notes.title: Mechanics update
notes.content:
Greetings Shoppers,

Today we're bringing you an update with a few changes that should significantly change the difference between the Blessed and Nameless difficulties.  Namely, the Ellpad will offer extra help for avatars in Blessed mode - the Ellnotes tell you whats next on your shopping list, and may offer help for other tasks as well.  Additionally, for those who find themselves lost in endless places, the Ellpad can give you a guiding line to where you're trying to go.

There are also some new things to interact with in the store, as well as things that may occur while shopping.

Finally, we implemented more bug fixes and corrected a few obscure items on the shopping list and made sure they should count towards lists correctly.

We have another update with a few more features and a few more bugs to fix coming soon, and I'm working on a big push to get a lot of the dialogue finished.  We have some new and exciting, awesome people who have offered to do voice acting for us, so we'll have more information on that soon!

Happy shopping!  We'll see you in the mist...

notes.title: Last Chance Market Opening Update
notes.content:
Attention
Last Chance Residents & Market Shoppers

It is with a heavy heart that I am writing to inform you that the opening of the Market will be delayed.  While I had hoped to have the repairs completed by the end of Elktober, I must admit the damage from the electrical fire earlier this summer, which claimed the lives of two people, was far more extensive than I had originally estimated.  With staff shortages limiting us to two full time employees, earthquake related road closures and regular power grid disruptions due to the ongoing solar flare activity, we have simply been unable to complete the work on our expected schedule.  My commitment is to the best shopping experience possible, and with that in mind I now expect us to be ready for shoppers in the second half of November.  In the meantime, we will be conituing our weekend Farmer's Market style sales in the parking lot until the store opens again.

On the bright side, we've taken this opportunity to update the store with some exciting new features.  Our new technology, featuring the deimOS AI system, is ready to make your visit to Last Chance Market better than ever.  We have a new interactive shopping assistant, the Ellpad, to help you quickly hunt down your shopping lists.  Swing by our new recipe kiosk to find delicious recipes featuring our sales of the day.  Or utilize the new self checkout to avoid waiting in line!

I do want to mention that we are still inviting participants in the annual Elktober FunHunt to park in our lot, conveniently located across from the starting point at Leng Forest Visitor Center.  We will have paintball supplies for those coming as Hunters as well as locally made, lightweight antlers for those participating as Elk.  Additionally, we will have GPS, maps and bear spray on sale for everyone involved.  A record number of forest search and rescues had to be made this year, be sure you FunHunt safely and responsibly!

Lastly, I want to give a big shout out to the Last Chance Secondary School's hockey team for the amazing fundraiser they had in the parking lot last week.  The community support was amazing and will allow them to get all the equipment they need this year.  Big thanks to everyone involved.  GO TSUNAMIS!

Looking forward to seeing you soon,
Tom Douglas
Last Chance Market Proprietor 

Transcribed from the Leng Tribune weekend insert.
